_comment: Curated, not live — see docs/research/12-ferry-dive-site-data-sourcing.md for the same 'no structured source exists' pattern this follows. Hours/fees/scam warnings confirmed via live research 2026-09-11 across multiple current travel guides (border fees and hours are known to change; re-verify every few months, same cadence as ferry_routes.json).

crossings.name: Belize–Mexico Border (Santa Elena / Subteniente López)
crossings.hours: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM daily on both sides. Late-evening processing is slow and onward transport on the Belize side largely dries up after 5–6 PM.
crossings.documentsNeeded: Valid passport, ideally with 6+ months' validity remaining. Crossing with a rental/hire car needs a separate import permit — few rental companies allow cross-border travel at all, so confirm before renting.
crossings.fees: Belize land-border exit fee: ~US$20 (BZ$40 — a departure fee plus PACT conservation fee plus a border development fee). Travelers transiting through in under 24 hours without an overnight stay in Belize skip the PACT portion, paying roughly US$16. No fee to enter Belize. Mexico's own tourist fee is normally already bundled into flight tickets — overland travelers should confirm with Mexican immigration whether anything separate applies to them.
crossings.scamWarnings: There's no official transport right at the crossing itself — travelers are commonly shuffled between taxis quoting inflated fares (often US$25–35 for a short hop). Confirm the price before getting in, or ask locally whether walking across is an option.
crossings.sourceNote: Hours/fees/scam pattern confirmed via live search across multiple current (2025-2026) travel guides. Position from a dedicated border-crossing reference site (Barry's Borderpoints), not independently surveyed.

crossings.name: Belize–Guatemala Border (Benque Viejo del Carmen / Melchor de Mencos)
crossings.hours: Belize side 4:00 AM – 10:00 PM · Guatemala side 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM — effectively 6 AM–10 PM for crossing in either direction.
crossings.documentsNeeded: Valid passport, ideally with 6+ months' validity remaining.
crossings.fees: Belize land-border exit fee: ~US$20, same structure as the Mexico crossing. Guatemala charges no official entry/exit fee, though a small unofficial "toll" (roughly 10–50 GTQ) is sometimes requested — treat it as optional unless whoever's asking can produce a receipt.
crossings.scamWarnings: The walk across the border itself takes about 2 minutes — don't pay for a taxi ride or accept paid "help" crossing on foot. Avoid taxi drivers waiting at a stand who claim a long distance into town; wait for a moving colectivo charging the standard posted rate instead. Be wary of anyone on the Guatemalan side asking for a fee without offering a receipt.
crossings.sourceNote: Hours/fees/scam warnings confirmed via live fetch of a current (2025-2026) border-crossing travel guide. Position is Benque Viejo del Carmen's town centroid, not the exact checkpoint building.
